notes: Source-led registry for practical Ireland-relevant Water NbS story discovery. Priority is surface-water quality, aquatic ecology, water-related biodiversity, and implementable measures. Prefer RSS/API/listing pages over unrestricted scraping.

sources.name: EPA Ireland News Releases
sources.scope: Ireland environmental regulation, water quality, bathing water, catchment evidence, WFD and policy delivery

sources.name: EPA Consultations
sources.scope: Irish environmental consultations with relevance to WFD, surface water, pressures, regulation and implementation windows

sources.name: EPA Hydrometric Bulletin
sources.scope: Hydrology, rainfall, river flow, flood pressure, and water-related hazards relevant to NbS placement

sources.name: Catchments.ie
sources.scope: Water Framework Directive, catchments, LAWPRO/EPA water-quality stories, measures, monitoring and ecological status

sources.name: Local Authority Waters Programme
sources.scope: LAWPRO catchment science, community engagement, practical water-quality measures and Nature-based Surface Water Management

sources.name: Farming for Water EIP
sources.scope: Agricultural water protection, nutrient and sediment interception, farm measures, advice, and delivery

sources.name: National Parks and Wildlife Service News
sources.scope: Water-related biodiversity, protected aquatic habitats, wetlands, peatlands and nature restoration policy

sources.name: Inland Fisheries Ireland News
sources.scope: River habitat, fish passage, fisheries conservation, aquatic ecology, enforcement and water-related biodiversity

sources.name: Teagasc Environment Daily
sources.scope: Farm advisory stories on soil, water, nutrients, sediment, biodiversity and practical agricultural measures

sources.name: National Biodiversity Data Centre
sources.scope: Biodiversity data, citizen science, species and monitoring, with priority for water-related ecology

sources.name: Climate-ADAPT Nature-based Solutions
sources.scope: EU adaptation and NbS knowledge base, retained only when items connect to surface-water management or aquatic outcomes
